method.uniqueBy: Absolute asset URL within each route; a cross-route URL is fetched once per inventory run.
method.fetched: HTML plus script src, stylesheet, script/style preload and modulepreload references directly present in that HTML. No media downloaded.
exclusions: Inline JS/CSS counted only within HTML
Client-side hydration, execution, prefetch, API traffic, caching and service workers
method.caveat: Raw sizes are decoded response bytes; gzip sizes are locally recompressed estimates, not actual wire transfer, Brotli size, execution cost, loading speed, LCP, INP or CLS. Includes HTML-advertised preloads whether or not a browser would use them.

budgets.basis: Initial HTML-referenced external JavaScript and CSS URLs, unique per route; gzip level 9 estimate. Excludes HTML and all runtime/recursive assets.
